# docker_buildx_builders (Data Source)

Lists the buildx builders on the provider's daemon, like `docker buildx ls`: the daemon's `default` builder and every docker-container builder (its `buildx_buildkit_*` node containers), each with its nodes, status, BuildKit version and platforms. Running nodes are queried over BuildKit's API; a node that cannot be reached carries its error instead. buildx's client-side store and its current-builder marker are not read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_buildx_builders" "all" {}

output "builders" {
  # e.g. { default = "default", ci = "docker-container://buildx_buildkit_ci0" }
  value = data.docker_buildx_builders.all.endpoints
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `builders` (Attributes List) One entry per builder, same shape as the docker_buildx_builder data source `builder` output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--builders))
- `builders_json` (String, Sensitive) All daemon-visible builders and their nodes as one JSON array (Builder objects). Sensitive: driver options carry env.* values.
- `buildx_version` (String) The buildx release whose output format and semantics this type mirrors (pin v0.38.2); not a runtime binary, the provider never runs buildx.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of builders_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon (GET /version Version).
- `endpoints` (Map of String) Map of builder name to the endpoint of its first node.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon for this read/apply.
- `names` (List of String) Builder names, `default` first.
